page.layout: One page of text in a single column, running head at top centre; two marginal notes in the left margin, beside the second paragraph and beside its third-last full line.

main_text.p: Ferro, igne, omnia vastantur, omnia populantur. Fruges non amplius in oppida, sed in castra convehuntur, multoque plus belli quàm pacis tempore insumitur. Si rumor belli est, maiores urbes, & proprium frumentum servant, & aliunde magnam copiam coemunt, donec constet de pace & bello.

Iniquæ exactiones Principum.Principes quidam quorum officium esset subditis prospicere, tamen eorum nullam curam gerunt. Illi ipsi illos ad pauperiem etiam in fertilissimis regionibus redigunt, atq; in hac ætate retinent. Nimijs exactionibus populum onerant, magnis sumptibus aula alitur, plurimum in canes, equos, agasones, moriones, & huiusmodi monstra & res nihili insumitur, his inquam artibus subditorum opes exhauriuntur, quibus hæc omnia solvenda sunt. Ex quo & illud sequitur, ut populus his exactionibus ad desperationem quasi redactus, nō curat rem familiarem, edit, bibit, ludit, ne quid reliqui sit quod principes rapiant. Itaq, nunquā ex paupertate emergūt. Luxus pauperatis causa.Sed quid de illis dico, qui sub iniquis illis principibus vivunt? An non maxima & communis munis

page.notes: Right margin and foot of page are blank. No page number is printed. The last word "munis" is set indented at the right, as printed; it is likely meant as "munus" and is left as printed. The left-margin note "Luxus pauperatis causa." is cut across lines by the printer ("pau-" / "pertatis cau-" / "sa."), joined here. "Itaq," and "emergūt" have doubtful marks over the letters, read as printed.
